reviews.text:
The clean and spacious interior is a space where breathing naturally slows down, and the addition of terrace seating made it a great place to stay for a while.
What impressed me most was the brand coffee that was refined without acidity. The type that has a clear center even though it doesn't stand out, and the taste becomes clearer the more you take a sip. In this day and age where the taste of coffee is easily overpowering, it feels more difficult to find such a calm and balanced taste, but I felt like I found the answer here.
The time spent wandering around looking for a good cup of coffee was quietly resolved with this one cup. I highly recommend you try coffee.
The bakery also exceeded expectations.

Bar located on the L floor of the hotel
Gangnam area has a lot of hills, but this place is also located on a hill, so when you enter from the entrance, you are on the second floor.
It is located one floor lower using the central elevator. You can visit by moving to the lobby floor.

Price**
They have bottles, but they also sell them by the glass, so you can expect the cost to be around 20,000 to 30,000 won per glass for everything from cocktails to whiskey! The price seems to be neither too expensive nor too cheap. There is a signature menu with a different theme each season.

Atmosphere**
Because the hotel itself is a luxury hotel, the ceilings are quite high and the antique interior design provides a special experience. It is decorated like a study space, but the space is separated so you can enjoy it with a private feel.

This seems like a place I would want to go when a special guest or friend visits Korea in the future! It is said that you can visit even if you are not a hotel guest.

display_name: Living Beer Eulji Hospital Intersection Branch

reviews.author: Hyuksoo Lee
reviews.text:
atmosphere

The interior of the store combines retro sensibility with neon lighting to create a lively and young atmosphere. The electronic signboard on the ceiling (“Thanks for coming!”) is especially impressive, and there are ample tables, making it a great space to have a quick beer with friends or colleagues. Because it is an open kitchen style, you can see the kitchen atmosphere at a glance.

beer

Living Beer's signature draft beer is served very freshly. As you can see in the photo, the creamy foam layer rises steadily, and it is characterized by a smooth and clean swallow from the first sip. It has a subtle hop scent and a cool refreshing feel, making it a great accompaniment to snacks.

food

Sausage & Fries: A variety of sausages are provided, with grill marks and herb toppings bringing out the flavor. The French fries are thick wedge style and go great with beer.

Fried Chicken: The crispy batter is excellent, and the meat is still juicy on the inside. It's fried cleanly without being greasy, so it's perfect as a side dish for beer. It is served with french fries to complete a hearty dish.

service

The staff is friendly, and food and beer are served quickly. Beer glass coasters are placed on each table, giving it a clean feel, and it is well maintained overall.

Overall review

Eulji Hospital Intersection Branch is a casual pub where you can enjoy a light beer with friends. Fresh draft beer, generous snacks, and a unique retro atmosphere make it a recommended place for after-work dinners or weekend gatherings.

The popcorn that came as a basic snack was also delicious, and the staff were friendly, so I enjoyed it happily. It's a bit pricey, but overall I was satisfied with the experience.

Although this is a famous bar in Korea, it also serves world-class cocktails and whiskeys.

Based on an Italian concept, it perfectly embodies the taste, atmosphere, and spirit of Italy.

Everything is perfect, from the coffee, Campari, food and pleasant atmosphere.

This place is considered one of the best bars in Gangnam.

Order at least two cocktails (three or more if possible).

The bartender will understand your tastes and make the best recommendations.

Elegant, sophisticated yet friendly service, and above all, delicious food!

reviews.author: Jeong Ra-hyeon
reviews.text:
It was late in the evening, after 9 o'clock. Perhaps because it was Monday, there weren't many people and the weather was cool, so we sat on the terrace. There was good music and a nice atmosphere.
However, I thought it would be better when talking if the volume was adjusted a little lower.
There are many different menus, but local pizza is the signature menu and the taste was satisfactory.
I like the harmony of half and half. I wish there were more variety in the draft beer, and both lager and ale were fine, but lager went better with pizza. There are sections here: semi-basement, terrace, first floor, and second floor. When the weather is nice, there are plenty of seats on the terrace, so I recommend that. If you want to talk quietly, it would be a good idea to take a seat in the semi-basement.

reviews.text:
#PattyandVeggies @pattyandveggies_tavern 🍔

I went to eat a burger for a late lunch when it was popular, and I often only ate it through delivery. This was my first time going at night and I was surprised at how good it was. The atmosphere is nice, but even the mac and cheese and cocktails other than the burgers are delicious, so I ended up happily staying here!🍹

There was a woman who was cutting burgers by herself with a knife late at night, but people who know something seem to come here for a cozy drink and burger, so I highly recommend it.,,✨

reviews.author: Eun-seon (Ariel)
reviews.text:
The interior and layout are so impressive that the atmosphere quickly changes from everyday life to a date the moment you enter.

I went there thinking the patty was delicious, but the taste surpassed that.
It was the best homemade patty I've ever had.

Buy your own meat, chop it, and even season it.
The minced meat had a texture I had never tasted before, so I could tell right away that they minced it themselves, and the seasoning was also very good.

Good value for money

reviews.author: Vaseline Pure
reviews.text: First of all, the taste of the food is not bad. The compatibility of sauces and cheese is quite good. The combination of chili and Chinese style sauce was good, and the Emmental cheese served with the burger was also quite good. The problem was that the plating wasn't very rich compared to the price, so I thought it would be difficult for many customers to come back. The margins for non-alcoholic beverages are also too large. And the interior feels a bit overdone in a small space, so it doesn't feel like a luxurious whiskey bar or a comfortable burger cafeteria. Wouldn’t it have been better if the concept had been clearer in one direction?

reviews.author: dirty candy
reviews.text:
2023-08-15 Patty and Bezzies

I roughly filled the morning time.
Now to fill my stomach
I headed to a hamburger restaurant that I had wanted to visit for a long time.

Since I don’t know my way around Seoul, I follow the map app.
I wondered if this was a real restaurant. 🤔

Arrived 10 minutes before opening.
It was unfortunate timing, but
In the worst case, you'll have to wait in line before opening.
I thought it was better than not being able to eat. 😊

A unique system for ordering through Naver.

Because it’s not a place you can go often
After thinking about it for a while, I chose one burger.
P&V Cheeseburger 220g double patty.

I think it best expresses the taste of a hamburger in a simple way.
Now that I'm here, it's a thick patty.
I decided to eat twice as much.

I ordered an additional burger before it came out.
Chili cheese wedge fries came out.

A look that stimulates the appetite.
For me, a potato killer
It was truly the best side. 😋
Unless it's a dinner date
I would have ordered a beer right away... 😢
Wiping away tears, I ordered a Coke.

Not long after, the long-awaited hamburger appeared.
A visual that makes you gain weight just by looking at it.
I thought about eating it with my hands, but
I took the cutlery and ate it.

Well, the taste is okay, but what can I say...
I wondered, “Is this a hamburger?”
The patty was not finely chopped either.
It had quite a texture, almost like a steak.

I wanted to feel the unique taste of a hamburger.
Feeling regretful.
Next time, I will try a different flavor with a smaller patty.
Oh, of course you have to order potatoes then too... 😍

reviews.author: YennaPPa (Luscious.K)
reviews.text:
#Garosu-gil #Sinsa-dong #Patty&Bezies

"Wow!!! What's so delicious~~"

1. You can’t not try , which has become a hot topic in Changan these days. The reason I didn't like burgers a lot was because there weren't any good burgers in Korea, but these days, a lot of really good handmade burger restaurants are popping up, and burgers have become a pretty great eating out item. Of course, I ordered this restaurant's signature stone fastball winning item. With blue cheese...

2. The visual is that it has two patties that are twice as thick as those at a typical burger restaurant these days, and has a smokey aroma. As if you are watching a live video, you can witness the juice pouring out of the patty in real time.

3. When you taste it, you can smell the fire and feel the slightly over-caramelized exterior of the patty. It feels like the intense searing of a steak. The slightly hard caramelized part along with the texture of the meat increases the texture. At the same time, the juicy meat (actually fat...) increases the flavor. It is an incredible patty that competes only with meat and fire without any sweetness. That's two too.

4. The spicy blue cheese dip adds saltiness. A saltier, more intense hardcore burger is completed. It doesn't feel salty, but like well-made Italian... the flavor explodes.

5. Back when I lived in the U.S., I had my own signature burger where I bought a frozen beef patty at Costco, seasoned it with salt and pepper, grilled it, put it between bread, and just sprinkled ketchup on it. It is my favorite style of taste in the world, where I can only enjoy the taste of meat, and this restaurant perfectly presented me with a high-end version of that taste. Thank you so much.

6. To summarize the strengths of this house burger:
- Intense searing like steak: Locks in meat juices and increases fire flavor and texture.
- Juicy storm caused by appropriate fat ratio: If the mixed juice of flowing fat and gravy is not tasty, go vegetarian.
- Textured minced meat: The patty meat that is not ground too finely maximizes the chewy texture of the patty. If a regular patty has a round texture, this restaurant's patty is like tteokgalbi that has been well cut with a knife.
- Direct purchase seasoned only with salt and pepper: What's the need for sweetness? A proper burger only needs salt and pepper.
- The optimal grain bun that supports the juiciness of the meat: No matter how delicious the patty is, a bun that cannot support it is a failure. A bun like brioche would never go well here. It's obvious that it will be sweet and runny. The intensity of the grain bun, which seems to contain rye, holds this juicy patty together.
